cohort: The study included 1,016,073 individuals undertaking Trial of Labor After Cesarean (TOLAC) in the United States.
finding: The rate of uterine rupture among individuals undertaking TOLAC in the U.S. increased over time, from 0.20% in 2010 to 0.37% in 2022.
mod_finding: The rate of uterine rupture increased over time among patients pursuing a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC), from 0.20% in 2010 to 0.37% in 2022.
